analogy.rationale: SPHK1 is a lipid kinase whose product sphingosine-1-phosphate signals through S1P receptors and downstream PI3K/AKT and MAPK pathways, but these cells express few S1P receptors and SPHK1 inhibition produces only modest transcriptional changes. The closest reference classes are other kinase inhibitors, though their transcriptional overlap is limited.
